programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Little Gizmo was saved from death row by Denise from PAWS rescue. The little Shih Tzu is suffering chronic ear infections, and for the last three months since his rescue, Chris and Denise have tried unsuccessfully to treat the debilitating problem. Chris is now being forced to take extreme measures or Gizmo will never be able to find a new forever home.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A sudden problem with Jemima’s hind leg has put an abrupt stop to her full throttle lifestyle. The shorthaired pointer has shattered her cruciate ligament, and without surgery she will never be able to walk normally again. Can Andrew Marchevsky repair Jemima’s badly damaged leg?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris heads to Victoria in response to an SOS from a young volunteer at Safe Haven Horse rescue. 11 year old Tash has fallen in love with a surrendered appaloosa gelding, Charlie. Tash is worried about a huge lump growing on Charlie’s eye and she’s hoping Chris can save her much loved Charlie.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is at the Hunter Valley to check on one of the zoo’s oldest residents, Mal. The 30-year-old spider monkey has a huge lump growing inside his mouth that has started to bleed. Chris needs to examine the lump to determine if it’s an easily treatable infection or a life-threatening tumor. What’s the diagnosis for this much loved monkey?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Mini pig James’s obsessive digging has got him in serious trouble with the local authorities. If he doesn’t stop digging massive holes in the park, the council may ban him. Can Chris solve this porker of a problem?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: On this special episode… Chris travels to Thailand to work with a wildlife crusader. Edwin Wiek and his team care for hundreds of homeless animals, many of them victims of abuse. Urgent medical attention is needed for patients ranging from elephants to monkeys to a sunbear. Chris also witnesses what happens when Thailand’s desperate elephants run out of food and a place to live. It’s a touching and sometimes confronting journey.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A medical mystery for Chris as he tries to diagnose what’s wrong with a beautiful five month old border collie. puppy. Even Sash specialist surgeon Andrew is forced to look overseas for answers to this rare and baffling case. Plus we meet the newest member of the Bondi Vet family….Lisa’s tiny son, Hudson. Does he get on with his four legged brothers? Watch and smile.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Another remarkable journey for Chris. This time he travels to the remote parts of northern Kenya to see the work of a brave Aussie zoo keeper fighting to save some of the world’s most endangered animals. In this extraordinary episode, Chris treats an orphaned baby rhino, takes cover from gunfire as an anti poaching squad hunts down a killer and saves the life of a badly mauled goat. Plus the Bondi Vet meets some amazing women and finds out how their beautiful beads are saving wildlife and gets involved with a crazy jumping competition with some Masai warriors.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris Brown and Dr Lisa Chimes head out to the burnt regions of the Blue Mountains on the Sydney outskirts the day after some of the most intense bushfires on record. The mass evacuations of farms and properties have left animals injured, stranded or in distress. The Bondi Vet team take to the road to help where they can. The last thing Chris expected was to be treating a baby alpaca named Jersey. Jersey’s mother went into premature labour, brought on by the stressful evacuation of the herd from their fire threatened property. Now the new-born Cria (baby alpaca) is listless and deteriorating alarming.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In this episode of Bondi Vet, Georgie, a small rescue dog, is brought in to see Dr Chris Brown. Georgie has a massive growth on her leg and Chris discovers another lump that is possibly more sinister. she will need an immediate, marathon operation that Chris hopes the dog can survive.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris is heading to the Halls Gap Zoo in Western Victoria where Stephanie the Lemur awaits. Recently the keepers have noticed her left canine tooth has darkened and are concerned it is an infection that could become a major problem for the small Lemur, especially as they suspect she may be pregnant.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris has received a call from Tim Faulkner at the Australian Reptile Park. One of the parks kangaroo’s has a nasty lump under its chin and Chris needs to make an emergency dash to the park to perform an urgent operation, that is made more difficult as the roo is a mother with young joey.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: “It doesn’t get much better than this” is one of the first things that Dr Chris says when a 4 week old baby lion cub Zambi is brought into the Bondi Clinic. For safety reasons Zambi has had to be removed from her mother by carers Donna and Mandy from the animal welfare organization LOTL (Life On The Line) Rescue. Not only does the young lion require a medical checkup but she also needs a surrogate mother and Dr Chris has the perfect – while very strange solution. No one is sure if it will work.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is in Cairns, a place he loves because no case is ever straightforward in the tropics and he is not disappointed. His first case is to try to solve the mystery medical condition of Snoopy, a Jack Russell terrier, who at odd times suffers strange and potentially deadly attacks.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is still in Cairns working as a locum at the local Marlin Coast Vet Clinic and yet again the tropic north does not disappoint when it come the weird and wild animals. First up, Chris is called to a local crocodile park to treat Ted, a 5.4 metre monster with savage wounds to his snout after coming off second best in a fight.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is shocked when a wild Currawong that has been speared by a wooden skewer is brought into the clinic. The spear has been in place for a number of weeks and new skin is growing around the spear, which must be removed but Chris is concerned that the shock of surgery may kill the wild bird.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Pluto the singing Dalmatian has lost his voice and Chris fears that the cause may be sinister. Pluto is very special to Chris because he was one of Chris’ first every patients.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris is confronted by Benji, a small dog with a large heart murmur that Chris can feel before he even hears it. Without immediate surgery young Benji could die at any moment and Chris entrusts this tricky operation to the one person he knows can pull it off – Dr Andrew Marchevsky at SASH.

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: Alex and Gerardo team up to save a greedy groodle that swallowed a tube of glue, Brooke battles a large bone stuck deep inside a dog’s throat and a tiny kitten is rushed in after a play session with the family dog goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: On this episode of Bondi Vet ER Luna has been rushed in to Alex with shocking injuries, Gerardo desperately tries to save a new born puppy, and a sock has gone missing and Ollie is facing serious trouble.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Billy answers an SOS from farmers in North Queensland who have lost chickens to a giant snake. Rob performs surgery on a German Shepherd with a broken leg. Michael removes a strange growth from a beloved African pygmy hedgehog .

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Billy has a close call with the worlds biggest crocodile during a health check. Michael comes up with a plan to treat a kittens life-threatening pelvic issues. Rescue cat Thor needs Robs help to fix a severely blocked bladder.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Rob treats a horrific lump growing behind dachshund Leos eye. Billy has a battle trying to find a snake that has been seen dangerously close to a family home. A Maltese Shih tzu is rushed to emergency with possible tick paralysis.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Rob performs surgery on a greyhound puppy with a badly fractured leg. The team at SASH has to fit 8-year-old cat, Bubby with a pacemaker. Ewan performs surgery on French bulldog Tyson, who is rushed to emergency with sudden paralysis.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Billy removes an object stuck down the throat of a giant alligator, but its not a job for the faint hearted. 13 year old French Bulldog Piglet faces a life and death battle. And a cat is badly injured after being hit by a car.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Its double trouble for Dr Rob as he treats 2 meerkats and neither likes going to the vet. Louisa has to work out how to get close enough to treat an aggressive bull terrier. James must perform high tech surgery to fix a shocking deformity.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Mara treats a cat suffering severe breathing difficulties and makes a surprise discovery. A labrador is going downhill fast with severe heatstroke and Dr Olivia has her work cut out when confronted with a pet python.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Roxy the Groodle faces major surgery . Audrey steps right out of her comfort zone to conduct health checks on two adult cheetahs. Miniature poodle Bert has warts all over his body that need to be removed to improve quality of life.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has returned to Hamilton in country Victoria at the invitation of Hamilton Animal Health Clinic. As the city vet it’s hardly surprising that they give him the more unusual cases to deal with including Pepper, a pig that delivers still born piglets, twin foals where one is being rejected by its mother and a visit to a farm to test the fertility of their massive stud bulls by measuring the size of their jewels.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris needs to use all his detective skills to find out why the end of Zaza, a pygmy bearded dragon’s tail keeps mysteriously falling off.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Back at the Bondi Clinic small West Highland Terrier Mr Pettibone arrives on the back of owner Henry’s Harley Davidson Motorcycle. The bikie dog has a persistent ear problem and Chris thinks he has the perfect solution.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris is called out to Edgars Mission on the outskirts of Melbourne to deal with an extremely rare case - Charity the lamb was born without hooves on her right side and without some form of intervention her life will be cut short. Chris suggests something untried on a sheep in Australia - prosthetics hooves.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris is called out to visit 42 year old Galah Pretty, who has a fast growing lump on his leg that is deeply concerning to owner Maurizio. Even though surgery on the old bird could kill it Maurizio is not keen on Chris’ alternative.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: When miniature goat Monty enters the Bondi Clinic the vet nurses are all smitten until they discovery what the cute 4 week old is harbouring on his skin!

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Miniature Horse Charlie has a severe problem with his mouth that Chris needs to investigate, but getting access to the tiny creatures teeth becomes a near impossible task.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris receives a call from a Melbourne school principal. She has a 4 month old staffy called Juno whose health is deteriorating rapidly. Chris brings to the dog to Sydney to get a CT scan to find out what is happening with the young pup and what they discover is something so rare, only 20 cases have been recorded world wide. Juno’s blood vessels are all mixed up, and she requires a very high-risk surgery to have any chance of survival.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Ziggy the cat has a big problem – he weighs almost a third more than he should. Chris needs to re-educate both the cat and the devoted owner to ensure the cats deteriorating health is not compromised further.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In this very special program the Bondi Vet travels to England to fulfill a dream he has always had about working in the UK. He is invited to join a clinic in Cornwall where he is presented with all sorts of animals great and small. From a diary calf requiring urgent surgery, to a prize winning duck with a torn foot that needs to be repaired in time for her next showing. He also treats a large Siberian Eagle Owl that requires an operation to fix a bad eye and must give the all clear to release two Atlantic Grey Seals that were washed up in recent storms.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In an emotion charged episode, Chris is on a desperate rescue mission to save the life of a frail 3 day old orphan foal. Brulee has lost his mum, and won't survive unless Chris can find him a surrogate. But it's no guarantee a mare will accept the little foal.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris meets a labradoodle with a chronic sneezing problem. 2 year old Lulu suffers massive sneezing fits up to 4 times a day, and her devoted owner Kim is desperate for help. Chris fears Lulu may have a tumour.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has been invited to Abu Dhabi after a special invitation to visit an extraordinary veterinary hospital. The hospital is for sick and injured falcons, and they are treated like royalty. Chris has to preform delicate surgery on a falcon wing.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A tiny kitten has been found abandoned in a cardboard box, and Chris is shocked at the extent of her injuries. She desperately needs surgery to try to repair her shattered leg. Then it's a heartwarming search to find her a new home.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: The finale to Chris's trip is an unforgettable encounter with some of China's precious Giant Pandas. Chris is granted the rare privilege of hand feeding some youngsters. He's then allowed into the most sacred area of all - the panda kindergarten to meet the adorable babies.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is confronted with an unusual patient, an albino echidna. But there's a question mark over whether the extremely rare echidna is a male or a female. It will have to be anaesthetised so Chris can investigate.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Tiny Amari has been born with a badly twisted back leg. At just 3 days old she's one of the youngest kittens Chris has ever seen at the clinic. The brave little battler needs a series of splints to try to save her leg, and give her a second chance.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has travelled to the Cook Island to help out at a busy vet clinic in the capital Rarotonga. His first patient is Princess, a hit run victim. Chris quickly finds out just how tough it is looking after the local pets, with only basic facilities and limited supplies.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is spending 2 weeks volunteering at the busy Esther Honey vet clinic in the Cook Islands. This week his first patient is a much loved cat called Small One, which has part of its nose missing. Chris is immediately concerned that Small One may have a skin cancer.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris makes a special trip to Karara in Queensland to see Stubby, a tiny 3-week-old piglet, born with only one trotter. Stubby is struggling to get around. If the brave little battler is to survive, Chris needs to work out a way for her to walk normally.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew investigates a worrying lump on a horse for a possible killer disease, but can he get close enough to find out. And Doctor Rachel is feeling the pressure when a passionate wildlife warrior brings in two distressed little Aussies.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Romi faces multiple emergencies when Lucy the groodle crashes before and during surgery, and Andrew treats a seriously ill goat that could be infested with a life-threatening parasite.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew must make a life and death decision on a close friend’s pet cow. Rachel investigates why a friendly young Labrador has developed a worrying limp, but can she calm her terrified patient down enough to even treat him.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: On this episode a critically ill kangaroo infant has Andrew and the young joey’s rescuer worried for its life. Dr Romi has her hand full with eight lively puppies, but will they get a clean bill of health?

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: On this episode delicate surgery has Andrew anxious for Sally the cow’s future. And why is doctor Romi so over the moon?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris travels to Edgars Mission on the outskirts of Melbourne, where he is faced with a very woolly fugitive. Ben Hall is a sheep that was rescued after 5 years on the run, and Chris is shocked at the condition of his heavy coat. The thick, matted wool could be hiding all sorts of health problems.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is visiting remote Christmas Island where he has to help a seabird named Bill that is unable to fly. Bill is a rare Abbott’s Booby, and she's missing critical flight feathers. Chris needs to treat Bill's deformed wing, before starting rehabilitation with the young rescue bird.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Tim wants Chris to find out why Jack the koala has suddenly developed nasty bumps all over his face. Chris is so concerned, they take the little 2 year old to the local clinic for an immediate biopsy. When the results come back Tim is astonished to learn that Jack has acne.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A dairy buffalo called Penny has severely deformed horns, which are growing into her skull, dangerously close to her brain. Chris has to try to corral the timid 10 year old, and then carry out the painstaking job of carefully removing the horns.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is heading out to sea, to help try to save an endangered Grey Nurse shark, which has been spotted entangled in fishing line and with a hook stuck in its mouth. A specialist rescue team has been assembled and Chris is joining them in the water, to try to corral the injured shark so it can be brought to the surface.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is helping out at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns. His first patient is a young dog which has had a nasty encounter with a hedgecutter. Misty has ended up with deep cuts across her nose. How the young dog avoided more disastrous injuries is a miracle.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is helping out at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns, and his first patient is a rare Fijian iguana Called Ako. The Iguana hasn't been himself, and isn't eating properly. Chris needs to do an x-ray to try to work out what's going on. The results reveal a massive bladder stone inside the small animal, and he needs immediate surgery.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A little joey has been brought in to Chris at the Bondi clinic after its mother was hit and killed by a car. It's feared the frail orphan may have a broken leg, but carer Sandy is determined to give the little battler a chance. It's a huge challenge for Chris to try to repair the leg. It's a heart stopping moment when he finds if the risky surgery has been a success.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: On this episode of Bondi Vet a tense night in the ER as Chris fights to save a policeman’s pet which has been deliberately poisoned with snail bait . Add to that a mercy mission for a malnourished penguin washed up on Bondi beach and a scary operation for a seven month old pup whose leg is disintegrating.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In Episode 2 of Bondi Vet, Chris confronts a bizarre and shocking act of cruelty as a 12 year old cat is deliberately dumped in the Bondi surf and left to die. There’s also a depressed parrot caught in a bizarre love triangle and can Lisa help a beautiful Samoyed survive a killer tick bite?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: This week stand by for a ground breaking operation at the Bondi clinic. Elroy, the out of control bulldog is being desexed and Chris is about to give him the very latest fake silicone testicles direct from the United States. Lisa hopes a blood transfusion can save a senior citizen and some very different patients including a sick owl spreading some nasty bugs and a turtle that’s wandered way off track.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: On this episode you will lose your heart to a brave golden retriever and her devoted owner.Rosie has severely deformed legs and only major surgery can save her life. How will owner Angus find the money and will the operation work? Chris also introduces us to one of Bondi’s most delightful dog loving eccentrics and a cutting edge solution for a record breaking goat.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: You will never forget Chris’ desperate fight to save the life of an innocent hit run victim. Lisa helps little Zoe battle a poisonous snake bite, we follow a lame lorikeet learning to fly again and the power of puppy school.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In this episode a much loved Labrador in trouble after a head on collision with a car and Lisa is in a race against time to find the cause of a mystery illness that is threatening the life of a five month old kitten. As well, Chris heads to the bush and gets called out to help with a difficult birth.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An unforgettable story as Chris takes home a fragile baby kangaroo with the odds against him….. will the joey make it without his mum? Plus a helping hand for a puppy with a life threatening problem. And Chris confronts his archenemy…a chihuahua with a mean streak.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: This week, follow Chris behind bars and meet three beautiful pups who are changing prisoners’ lives, a terrible ordeal for a pregnant beagle as Lisa struggles to save her life, a bunny that makes the Bondi vet cry and surfing lessons for Chris’ kelpie…Rusty.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: So ugly he’s cute! Meet sharpei puppy, Mr Wilson who is running the risk of going blind because of the massive folds of fat that hang over his eyes. Chris is hoping an eyelift will allow Mr Wilson to finally see the world.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris tackles a tricky rescue mission to try to save a mother and her three ducklings. The family have set up home in a disused swimming pool at a building site but the pool is full of rubbish and one duckling has already died. A new address is needed urgently but catching these submersive creatures is going to be very difficult.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An eight month old kitten’s back legs have been shattered by a deliberate act of cruelty. Can Chris save eight month old Blackie?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two peregrine falcons that live at the top of a high rise shopping centre mall in busy Bondi Junction have been struck down with a mystery illness. Can Chris find the answer and return the beautiful birds to their penthouse home.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris faces one of the most traumatic nights of his career when Bella the pug is rushed into the Bondi clinic. She is in labour and x rays show she’s carrying six huge puppies. During an emergency caesarean Chris and a team of vet nurses battle to save the babies and a critical Bella.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two kooky cousins are worried their spoilt Pomeranian, Marie has swallowed some string from a bikini. Six month old Marie is vomiting and in pain and Chris has to try to diagnose the case while Hilary and Genevieve re decorate the clinic! Finally little Marie has to go to surgery and the girls are not coping. Watch for a whacky homecoming.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A mother duck has decided to hatch her nine babies on a high rise balcony. It’s a terrible choice. There’s no food, water or shelter from the sun and no way of getting out. Rounding them up is Chris’ first problem but their lives are in danger again when the release doesn’t go according to plan.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris heads to the bush this episode to try to sort out an intriguing call for help. Schnitzel is a sixteen month old daschund with a crazy obsession that’s putting his life in danger. Schnitzel won’t leave the new born calves alone and is in real danger of getting a kick to the head. The determined dog has already been trodden on and suffered a broken toe. Watch for farmer Scott’s scepticism about the vet’s left field solution. There’s also a mercy dash to help a calf with a fractured leg.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An emergency night call for Chris as a little schnoodle (cross schnauzer and poodle) is rushed in after being run over by a taxi on a busy road. Distressed baby sitters, Brad and Thomas have been looking after Toby while his owners are holidaying in Queensland. The accident victim is traumatised and suffering from a punctured lung. Can Chris save Toby or will Brad and Thomas have to make a terrible phone call?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A case close to Lisa’s heart. Seven month old Danny nearly died from a paralysis tick bite when he was just a few weeks old. Now he’s back at Sash struggling to walk and breath. His doting owners think their precious golden retriever puppy has swallowed something but Lisa discovers Danny’s life is under threat once again.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris turns detective to find out how the tiny Splodge is managing to escape from his backyard by climbing straight up a three metre brick fence. The neighbours are all happy to see the little Houdini but Splodge is dicing with death. He’s already been run over once and had his leg broken. What will the spy cameras reveal and how can Chris outsmart the cunning Splodge.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A four week old lamb with a broken leg has been dumped at an animal farm. Chris has decided little Leroy deserves a shot at life and takes the lamb back to the clinic to try to save his fractured leg and his life. Watch for Leroy’s introduction to Bondi Beach where Chris passes him off as a brand new breed of lamb-radoodle.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Sydney is being lashed by a huge storm and a tiny penguin has been washed up on Bondi beach. The little fella is malnourished and having trouble standing up. When Chris discovers what is causing the problem, he is shocked and forced to make a tough decision. Watch for the Bondi vet committing a fashion crime with some very floral board shorts.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris leads an Australian vet team overseas to help the animal victims of Fiji’s devastating cyclone. Working with him is his Dad, Graeme, a vet with 42 years experience. Together they stitch up a horse which has been ripped apart by a piece of flying corrugated iron roof. Watch out for some interesting family disagreements. Lisa has to make the adjustment from her hi tech hospital at home to treating animals in primitive conditions. Chris is also invited to an exclusive island resort to treat a cantankerous 170 kg pet pig. Unforgettable.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A hit run victim collapses in a designer dress shop. Willow, a seven year old Husky, can only drag herself along the ground. Chris comes to the rescue but will Willow ever be able to walk again?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has a second call out. This time, it’s a Norwich terrier struggling to deliver her first litter of pups. It’s an emotional rollercoaster as Chris tries to save the puppies and keep the mother alive. The eight hour drama ends with a dash to the Bondi clinic for emergency surgery.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Three month old rescue puppy Tyson is being fostered by a family for just one week. But when foster Mum, Melissa takes the puppy to Chris for a routine check up she is confronted with terrible news. Tyson needs major heart surgery or he will die. Despite the expense, the family decide to adopt Tyson because they know no one else will give him a home in his condition. Will Tyson survive the openheart surgery and have a happy future with his new family?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has rushed to the Australian Reptile Park to handle an emergency. Two Tasmanian devil babies, Lara and Lily have been struck down with a mystery illness and are close to death. Can Chris save the two critically ill sisters or is the entire devil population at the park in danger of being wiped out?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two boxer puppies are found by police wandering the streets. One has been hit by a car and is coughing up blood. Chris is called to rescue the brothers. First, he must treat the hit run victim but then it becomes his mission to track down their owners and prevent them going to an animal shelter. The trouble is Chris is bonding with the puppies and is going to find it hard to let go.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A miniature horse who is suffering from dwarfism disease was not meant to survive past six months. However his loving owner and a dedicated band of vets have beaten the odds and kept 2 year old Koda alive. Australia’s smallest horse is also a regular visitor at the Royal Children’s Hospital in Melbourne and lights up the lives of hundreds of sick kids. Now, however, the brave Koda faces another life threatening operation. Chris will be part of the elite surgical team that will decide Koda’s fate.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two heartbroken little girls and their Mum are pleading for Dr Chris to save their beloved bunny. The family came home to find something shocking had happened to little Alice. The rabbit is the girls’ first pet and only 14 weeks old. This will be one of Dr Chris’ toughest cases.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A beautiful kelpie is brought to Chris in a terrible state. A knock to the head as a puppy has caused severe balance problems but his condition is now deteriorating rapidly. His loving owner Heidi already has a baby to look after but she is constantly assisting Jasper and cannot bear the thought of losing him. In desperation, she looks to Chris for an answer. A brain scan shows his problems are inoperable but Chris refuses to give in. A custom made cart is fitted for Jasper and the sight of him moving about with his new “ wheels” is a heart warming salute to love and persistence.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Jen brings in her son’s dog Jewel to Dr Chris to find out if she’s expecting. The complication? This is an unplanned pregnancy and Jen suspects the father is her own dog, Token. X rays prove Jewel is having a football team of puppies. Get ready for a long night of anxiety, sadness and ultimately joy as Dr Chris helps Jewel through her ordeal. Funny scenes as proud father, Token keeps a close eye on proceedings to make sure his offspring are being well looked after.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A beautiful pig is about to become pork chops if she keeps digging up the family property with her broken nose ring. Her owner, Allison loves Lola and has asked Chris to find a way to stop the execution. A new nose ring is the answer. Sounds easy but sedating an angry pig turns out to be a tough challenge. Watch out for some hilarious chase scenes.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Honey has taken a death-defying leap out of a car doing 40 kms an hour to chase down a cat. Somehow the spoodle has survived but just how serious are her injuries? Owner, Ilana is suffering enormous guilt that she didn’t have the family’s pride and joy safety strapped in the car. Watch for the cat hating spoodle’s reaction when she hears her archenemies out the back of the Bondi clinic.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris finally has a weekend off vet duties and is heading to Newcastle to catch up with his parents. But a call from his dad about a bizarre snake emergency sends him on a fascinating detour. What has the huge python swallowed that is now threatening to kill him? This a case of truth being stranger then fiction.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A game of chasey at home turns ugly for Hooligan when he runs into his owner, Sarah. Hooligan’s horribly fractured leg needs major surgery at Sash but the tiny terrier has never spent a night away from his family and is not coping.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is about to be confronted with the smallest patient he has ever handled. Twelve-year old Elliot’s much-loved pet mouse, Pinot has developed a massive, cancerous tumour. But surgery on such a pint-sized patient is going to be a real challenge. Will Pinot pull through or will a young girl be shattered?

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: Alex and Gerardo team up to save a greedy groodle that swallowed a tube of glue, Brooke battles a large bone stuck deep inside a dog’s throat and a tiny kitten is rushed in after a play session with the family dog goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: On this episode of Bondi Vet ER Luna has been rushed in to Alex with shocking injuries, Gerardo desperately tries to save a new born puppy, and a sock has gone missing and Ollie is facing serious trouble.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Homer the turtle is going on holidays while his owner is overseas. What can go wrong? Well ...try finding the little fellow in the fangs of the resident pooch. Babysitter Jody is guilt ridden and the traumatised Homer is the victim of a big bacteria bite. Can Chris save the day for everyone?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris heads to the Victorian high country to help out a mate and to realise a boyhood dream of becoming a vet in the bush. It’s a challenging week as he treats everything from horses to wombats and monkeys and helps save a mother in trouble. Monkeys carry some nasty diseases and watch for Chris’ concerns about what he might leave Mansfield with. Talk about a dangerous job.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Pearl was at her regular hairdressing appointment when she started bleeding internally. Now the pampered poodle may have minutes to live and Chris is her only hope.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Little Lucu has been attacked by a paralysis tick and the poison is rapidly shutting down her system. A round the clock watch is needed to keep this innocent victim alive. But will it be enough?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A bizarre looking baby cockatoo has fallen twenty metres out of her nest and wants to alert the whole world to her plight. Can Chris help the little screamer and will she ever be able to fly?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An emotional case for Chris as he fights to save one of the clinic’s favourite patients. Beautiful Bluebell was dumped on the doorstep of the clinic as a kitten and adopted out to a loving family. Now Bluebell is the victim of a hit run accident and all the staff at Bondi are directly affected.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: The Australian Reptile Park operations manager, Tim Faulkner ropes Chris into a frightening mission in far north Queensland. A monster seven metre python called Big Mamma is living in the roof of a local boating club and the female paddlers are terrified. It’s all up to the intrepid duo as they head to Cairns to try to capture the scary reptile.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A quick thinking police officer in Sydney’s infamous King Cross has rescued a twelve-week old puppy and rushed her into the Bondi clinic. The puppy was found sweltering in forty degree heat in a plastic handbag and the culprit has been arrested. Little Tilly soon finds a place in Chris’ heart and home where she has a confrontation with the resident cat, George. Without a microchip, the search is on for her owner.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A morning walk has gone tragically wrong for Tigger and his distressed owner Bernadette. A street cleaner spooked the five year old and sent him charging into a car. Chris is trying to calm them both down to find out the extent of Tigger’s injuries.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Ziggy is a dog with an embarrassing problem. A huge mass is hanging off his back leg. Bemused vet nurse Neil tells us its like “ a third testicle swinging in the wind.” But when it comes to surgery it’s no laughing matter for Chris.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Boris the Staffy was born with a cleft palate. Lucky to survive, he has now endured seven operations to try to fix the gaping hole in his mouth. All have failed and time is running out. Chronic infections are now destroying his quality of life. Like Boris, his owner Jess is refusing to give up. She’s written to Chris looking for one last chance. The surgery will be the first of its type ever performed in Australia. Eight thousand dollars needs to be raised and Chris is prepared to go all the way for Boris!

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: West Highland terrier, Chester lives in Bondi but has a fanatical hatred of skateboarders. It’s a dangerous combination and one that is making life hell for his owners Mark and Jess. They’re worried Chester could bite someone and end up in serious trouble. What can Dr Chris come up with to tame the savage terrier?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: 6 month old German Shepherd, Gypsy hasn't been able to keep any food down for weeks and is losing weight rapidly. But getting to the bottom of the problem is proving impossible as the petrified patient refuses to let anybody examine her. Lisa is seriously concerned about what has happened to this young pup. Will it be a happy ending for Gypsy?

programme.title: Is It Haunted?
programme.desc: After 1066, William the Conqueror established the mark of his authority in every important place, and the town of Wisbech, at that time on the sea, was deemed worthy of a stone fortress. In 1236, both Town and Castle were swept away in a terrible inundation. The castle remained in ruins for the better half of a century, and then was rebuilt and became one of ten castles, palaces and manor houses attached to the See of Ely. In the times of persecution, Wisbech Castle became a state ecclesiastical prison, incarcerating Catholics in the reigns of Elizabeth, James I and Charles I and Protestants in that of Queen Mary. Many were executed. It is possible even that the Gunpowder Plot was hatched at the Castle. Since Wisbech was a Cromwellian area, the Castle, by now in a state of terminal dilapidation, was sold in 1658 to the Right Honourable John Thurloe, Cromwell’s Secretary of State. He had the ruined castle demolished and replaced it by a most elegant house designed by Peter Mills, a pupil of Inigo Jones. At the Restoration, Thurloe’s Mansion reverted to the See of Ely and was occupied by members of the Southwell family over a period of a hundred and five years. Then in 1792 it was put up for sale, and purchased by Joseph Medworth, a former Wisbech Charity boy who had succeeded in business. He offered it for sale to the Corporation for the use of the Grammar School, but they declined. Medworth had the Mansion demolished. Using much of the same materials, he managed to replace it with the regency villa, which stands today.

programme.desc: When the hit show actress Jenna Wilde stars in suddenly gets cancelled, the press start circling. To escape the chaos Jenna retreats to a snowy cabin in the mountains. Unexpectedly, she must share this peaceful place with a rude and rugged nature photographer Chris Dixon. Their coolness towards each other starts to thaw when Chris helps Jenna audition for other shows.

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Loyalty and Larceny
programme.desc: Broke couple Deon and Tiff accidentally steal a package of premium weed meant for a local dealer working under Queen Pin. Forced to become rookie dealers in Dallas to pay off their debt, they fumble their way through the drug game while trying to survive the ruthless Queen Pin and a vengeful rival, C-Mo. When they uncover a deeper betrayal, they must fight for their lives and a shot at running their own LA empire.

programme.title: New Year New Us 2: #LoveGoals
programme.desc: On a mission to maintain a successful marriage in a city full of temptation, Bakari & Imani are trying their best to get on the same page. But just when things seem to be getting back on track, secrets and lies threaten to tear down everything they've built.

programme.title: Restraining Order
programme.desc: A married woman of 10 years, longs for a life of luxury and opulence. An old flame begins to catch her eye as a means to fulfill that dream, at the cost of her jealous husband. He begins to cause a storm of terror, where she fears for her safety.

programme.title: Curfew: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: Former police captain Thomas Cooper, once a respected figure, finds himself entangled in a dangerous deal with a notorious crime boss. His involvement leads to a love triangle and ultimately a betrayal. Now, haunted by his past, Thomas must confront the consequences when his son, Christian, becomes a target of the crime boss's revenge.

programme.title: Swept
programme.desc: Five old friends receive invitations to their 20 — year high school reunion, hoping to connect and reminisce. Little do they know, they've all been keeping a secret about events that unfolded over twenty years ago. Will secrets stay buried? Or with the weight of their guilt finally tear them apart?

programme.title: Pretty Girls Kill
programme.desc: In 2004, Ruby, a college student witnesses a supernatural horror at a local sorority house where three women, known as The Takers, kill and drain the life out of her friends to preserve their youth and beauty. 20 years later, now a detective, ghosts from her past resurface, and she must face these demons once again.

programme.title: A Secret Lie in Love
programme.desc: Clarice and Chase Scott have the perfect suburban life on the outside. However, their marriage that was built on passion, has become a battlefield of deceit, infidelity, and betrayal. Clarice finds solace in the arms of another man, while Chase’s greed seems to unravel everything they’ve built. Will their marriage survive?

programme.title: The Forsaken
programme.desc: After discovering an old book, Alex becomes drawn into the harrowing stories of cowboys Latt and Stylz. As he reads about their treasure hunt and daring adventures, Alex finds inspiration in their courage and friendship to use in his own life and help him find the strength to overcome his own obstacles.

programme.title: Untangled Mirror
programme.desc: J. Nicole is a determined mother, entrepreneur, and hairstylist fighting to balance her personal and professional worlds while navigating love, family, and the weight of false perceptions. By day, she runs her salon with pride, presenting herself as confident and successful. But behind closed doors, she faces child custody battles, tense encounters with her ex, and a controlling new partner.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Vices
programme.desc: Simone, a married woman battling anxiety and the lingering shadow of her past alcoholism, escapes to collect her thoughts. When a storm isolates her in her remote cabin, she’s hunted by two forces: the seductive pull of her past addiction, and a cunning serial killer. Surrounded by a web of lies and sin, Simone must face her inner demons before a literal one ends her life.

programme.title: Guilty Victim
programme.desc: A dangerous investor with a violent past is pulled back into chaos when a home security scheme spirals out of control, forcing him to confront old wounds, betrayal, and a brutal fight to protect what little he has left.

programme.title: Deeper
programme.desc: The story of Chasity, King, and Gotti is a tale of love, betrayal, and power. Gotti returns with a vengeance, seeking to reclaim his Dallas Kingpin status and Chasity's love. Despite their challenges, Chasity and King remain determined. As they plan their future, Gotti's secrets and power grab threaten their love. Will they triumph over his schemes or will he steal her heart? Follow their journey in the dangerous world of the hustle.

programme.title: Dr. Ira Reid: Haverford College's Unsung Scholar Activist
programme.desc: Dr. Ira De Augustine Reid, was a prominent sociologist and proficient writer who wrote on the lives of black immigrants and communities throughout the United States. Follow along his story of perseverance and relentless pursuit and how he became the first tenured African-American Faculty member of Haverford College and left a historical impact on the world of academia.

programme.title: Dirty Cops LA
programme.desc: Ex-hustler turned cop, Detective Jackson and his Partner Detective Johnson, an ex-gang member turned shady do-gooder, bring a new meaning to the phrase "boys-in-blue". Normally pre-occupied with robbing and assaulting the city's criminal element, they also make time to close a few cases along the way. The city has been taken over by an outsider known as "El Jefe", a Mexican drug lord that has decided to make LA his new home. Jackson and Johnson plan on helping him get "settled in".

programme.title: Dope Boy Magic
programme.desc: In the rough streets of Lumberton, NC, Mario wants to take the fastest path possible to a better life. Growing up with a father who was a pimp and a mother who was a prostitute, he only saw the worst in humanity on a nightly basis. Failing out of school and penniless, the only options were selling drugs, and theft. He started out breaking and entering, robbing trailer homes of known dope boys, who take notice and action.

programme.title: Complexions
programme.desc: A dark skin aspiring actress is thwarted in love and work all because the color of her skin. When caught lightening her pictures online, her supportive father and light skinned best friend struggle to help her on her journey to love herself.

programme.title: Captured
programme.desc: Jessica Johnson, a journalist, has just learned that her brother has died. Upon moving into his apartment to pick up his belongings she notices an old camera. She has no idea about the secrets behind the camera left behind. It's only a matter of time before she begins to hear and see visions only behind the camera or whenever the camera is near. Is it real? or is she hallucinating?

programme.title: Bissonnet
programme.desc: When Drea gets kicked out of school, she turns to the streets to make some money. What she does not know is that fast money and life on the streets of Bissonnet come at a high price.

programme.title: The Perfect Mother
programme.desc: Linda, a determined mother, faces the daily struggles of raising her son Ahmad amidst the unpredictable presence of her husband Jeremy. When a series of hardships push her to the edge, Linda's plea for assistance inadvertently leads to Ahmad being taken into CPS custody. Linda rises to the challenge of overcoming adversary to reunite her family and save her son.

programme.title: BARS
programme.desc: Kobe lives a picture-perfect life. A devoted wife and mother, she has everything she's ever wanted. But her idyllic world shatters when she's abruptly arrested and sentenced to life in prison for a crime she didn't commit. Desperate for survival, Kobe finds solace and strength in a tight-knit group of inmates known as The Pretty Girls. Unaware of Kobe's ordeal, her twin sister Shaq returns home only to discover the shocking truth.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Karmen, a successful businesswoman is secure and thriving in every part of her life, except for love. She downloads a dating app and seems to have found Mr. Right in Jermaine, but her best friends warn her that he might be a scammer. As Karmen falls deeper, she slowly falls victim to a network of lies and deceit, that could cost her life.

programme.title: Rage: Kill or Be Killed
programme.desc: Jackie “Labrae” Robinson dominates Houston’s unsanctioned boxing circuit—until he comes face-to-face with the one opponent, he never imagined fighting: his personal hero, legendary champion Theo Barnes. However, Theo is a haunted man dealing with his own demons and an advanced case of CTE. A first meeting quickly escalates into an all-out brawl, making the stakes of two champion fighters that much higher.

programme.title: Vampire Genesis
programme.desc: Half-alien Teh'a flees across galaxies, hunted by a race of parasitic rulers disguised as Earth's vampires. With rebels by her side, she seeks a legendary creature: the first vampire, powerful enough to end their reign of terror.

programme.title: Kiss Me Once
programme.desc: Gabrielle, a delusional romantic, fixates on anyone who shows her the slightest interest. Her obsession turns dangerous when her feelings aren't reciprocated.

programme.title: Boyz for Life
programme.desc: When the notorious "Fufu: The Furious Frenchmen" steals Escobar's last stash from the LAPD evidence room, mismatched detectives Larry and Bernie are on the case. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect witness Julia, navigating LAPD bureaucracy and a cast of quirky characters. This action-comedy blends thrilling chases, unexpected romance, and heartwarming moments of unlikely friendship, proving that even in the face of international villainy, laughter and brotherhood can prevail.

programme.title: Scandalous
programme.desc: Lady Watts, a bestselling author, reveals secrets about her affairs with those closest to her in her latest memoir. At her launch party, a heated argument turns violent, and she's left unconscious. As detectives investigate, secrets, love triangles, and betrayal emerge. The search for the attacker leads to twists and turns, involving everyone from her talent manager to her labelmate. The truth about the night of the attack is slowly revealed, with unexpected consequences for all involved.

programme.title: The Groomer
programme.desc: Layla is a young and attractive woman who meets Bryce in her teen years, and he is who she claims to be the love of her life. Unbeknownst to her, Bryse is manipulating her and forming her into his own object of desire. Layla is under his spell, until a different side of him that could destroy her.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Drug kingpin Jay looks to expand his drug empire with the help of his business partners, and his girlfriend Passion. However, Polo and Marco have their own agenda’s, which could lead to chaos, as a potential drug war descends upon Atlanta.

programme.title: Legends of the Highway
programme.desc: Follow the true story of the Florida Highwaymen, 26 self-taught African American artists who forged their own path to success in the segregated 1950’s and 60’s. Their stories are guided by the mentorship of renowned landscape painters A.E. Backus, Alfred Hair, and Harold Newton. Their troupe captured Florida’s breathtaking landscapes and sold their paintings along state highways, circumventing the traditional art world that excluded them.

programme.title: Trap A Fool
programme.desc: After two years of what he thought was a perfect relationship, Jeremiah uncovers his beloved Shay-Shay's "black book" of men. He is forced to realize that her gentle nature was a facade, a calculated move in her "game of fools." Shay-Shay's only loves are herself, sex, and money, and their dangerous game is about to end.

programme.title: Quiet as Kept
programme.desc: Jay is unlawfully detained. His ex-girlfriend returns, and his business partners work to clear his name. Meanwhile, a crooked cop is under suspicion for murder, and connections are made between him and Jay. Torn between duty and loyalty, Detective Johnson is caught in the middle. As the prosecution struggles, Jay and his business partners work to exist the dangerous world cleanly.

programme.title: Only 48
programme.desc: When Tracy Harris is abducted and held for ransom, her father Keith has only 48 hours to deliver $500,000. Forced back into the criminal world he tried to escape; Keith faces dangerous alliances and hidden truths in order to save his daughter.

programme.title: For All Have Sinned
programme.desc: After the sudden death of his mother, Mano embarks on a violent path that stems from his grief and causes him to spiral. He lives by the mantra of Romans 3:23 “for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” When a local church members attempts to reach him, he finds a way to navigate his pain and grief.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The second stage of Strongman champions league will be hosted in Germany, by FIBO - the leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health worldwide with 300,000 visitors in four days. Special implements like the biggest log in the world or the special Bavarian stone lift are not only a challenge, but also an opportunity for new personal, national and world records.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Holland is hosting 12 different countries with 14 of the strongest men in the world for the third stage of the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we go into the mountains of Austria to find out through six grueling events who is the strongest in the land of Alps. Martin Wildauer, current World Champion 2014 and Austrian local is competing alongside Zageris, Radzikowski, Belsak and many others.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 13th stage of Strongman Champions League is in Maia, Portugal. The competition is at the “Powerexpo” – one of the best sport and fitness events in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage is in Martinique and eight strongmen from all over the world will compete for the last chance to gather points before the world grand finals in December.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 15 outstanding competitions all over the world, finally we are here at the final competition of this year’s Strongman Champions League hosted in Turkey.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Experience the pinnacle of collegiate pickleball as Virginia Tech and Liberty University battle for the NCPA 2025 Virginia Beach Regional title. This high-stakes championship matchup features a prize pool of $2,500 and a chance for regional dominance.The action kicks off with an elite men’s doubles match featuring Liberty’s Ben Rice and Derek Cray against Virginia Tech’s undefeated Cody Miller and Caelan Funk. The broadcast also captures intense singles play and critical mixed doubles rallies as both teams fight through high-tension dink battles and "Dreambreaker" level strategy. Watch for standout defensive plays, including ATP (Around the Post) attempts and high-speed hand battles on the Championship Court at Pickleball Virginia Beach.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the high-octane energy of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) Season 2 as the Bengaluru Jawans go head-to-head with the Rajasthan Titans at the iconic Jio World Garden in Mumbai. The stakes are higher than ever in this Day 9, Tie 16 clash, featuring elite matchups such as the "women's singles player of the season" Katrina Stewart facing off against the resilient Lorena Dupnik. Watch as tactical masters like Dusty Boyer and Jack Foster battle for supremacy in a series of intense singles and mixed doubles competitions where every point counts toward the league standings. With game-changing "Pickle Plays" and atmospheric "drums" fueling the intensity, this tie is a masterclass in professional grit and strategic precision.

programme.title: All Florida Pro League
programme.desc: Commentators provide an inside look at Game 2 of the All Florida Pro League (AFPL) Stop 4 in Sarasota, Florida. The Fort Myers Flamingos get off to a dominant start, but the Jacksonville Ballers refuse to give up, staging a dramatic late-game comeback that tightens the score and mounts the pressure. This episode features key players like Stevie, Sophia Dorsey, and Maddalena, with highlights of their strategic plays and powerful shots. Tune in to see if the Flamingos can hold on to their lead and close out the game against the surging Ballers.

Oncins is a former professional tennis player from Brazil. His partner, Simone Jardim, is a professional pickleball player, a Pickleball Hall of Fame inductee, and was once ranked the number one female player in the world. programme.title: 2026 Elite Season
programme.desc: Day 4 brings Championship Sunday drama as finalists execute late adjustments and strategic decisions, with critical final-hour catches turning a close race into a decisive victory on a demanding river system.

programme.title: 2026 Elite Season
programme.desc: The Final Day Weigh-In highlights the culmination of four days of competition as anglers showcase their best limits, with a standout performance and late big fish sealing a dominant win on the Arkansas River.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix had an impeccable smallmouth record in Bassmaster Elite Series events prior to Lake Oahe, but the Minnesota pro went to another level after four successful days in South Dakota. In the Marathon Peak Performance at Lake Oahe, watch Austin Felix take home his first tour-level victory with Bassmaster.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Kyoya Fujitia
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, watch Kyoya Fujita take the title at Lake Champlain for the first B.A.S.S. win of his career. The young Japanese prodigy stormed to 5 Top 10's in his Rookie season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Cook
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Drew Cook (‪@thecutlinetv‬) has been a strong competitor since joining the Elite Series in 2019, but a win has eluded him early in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: First year Bassmaster Elite Series pro Joey Cifuentes dominated the Lake Seminole Elite event and took his first pro-level victory. Cifuentes outlasted the field with a four-day total of 85 pounds, 2 ounces. In this Marathon Peak Performance you can watch his winning week.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Justin Hammer
programme.desc: ‪@justinhamnerfishing‬ followed his passion and that dream led him to the Bassmaster Elite Series. After a few years on the Elites, he was in the catbird seat of the 2024 Bassmaster Classic where his lifelong dream came true and he became the World Champion of bass fishing. Watch his week unfold at Grand Lake O' the Cherokees in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: Through just 5 years on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Patrick Walters has an incredible resume. He added another accolade with a win at Lake Murray, doing so in impressive fashion. Congratulations to ‪@patrickwaltersfishing5121‬, he is the Marathon Peak Performance at the 5th stop of the 2024 season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Will Davis Jr.
programme.desc: In his Marathon Peak Performance of the week, watch Will Davis Jr. win his first Bassmaster Elite Series title in dramatic fashion on his home body of water. Davis won by just 2 ounces over Brandon Palaniuk, making it the closest margin of victory since Toledo Bend of 2011.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Takumi Ito
programme.desc: Taku Ito got another blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series with his big win at Smith Lake. Relive his week in Alabama where he conquered spotted bass en route to his second Elite Series win since joining the top ranks in 2020.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie Classic
programme.desc: A story a decade in the making unfolded at the 2022 Bassmaster Classic when ‪@Christiefishing‬ notched his first Classic victory at Lake Hartwell. Watch Christie's Marathon Peak Performance from start to finish as he climbed the mountain in the sport of bass fishing and achieved the biggest win in the sport.

programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince
programme.desc: Watch Cliff Prince's winning week at Wheeler Lake in this edition of the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament. Prince found a magical spot where the fishing was on fire the first two hours of every tournament day and it lasted all four days en route to his first blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series. The area was 4 to 5 feet deep and Prince maintained a low profile and fished his chatterbait around grass and over a hard spot without using his forward facing sonar.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Buddy Gross
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the Harris Chain of Lakes went to Buddy Gross who came from behind to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch Gross go to work and win big in Florida.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brock Mosley
programme.desc: In his 8-year Bassmaster Elite Series career, Brock Mosley has been so close to major titles but fallen just short with 5 2nd place finishes and even more Top 10’s. Watch Mosley put four great days together on his way to his first Elite Series title at the 2023 Folds of Honor Bassmaster Elite at the Sabine River and take home the Marathon Peak Performance!

programme.title: Peak Performance - Lee Livesay
programme.desc: Walk on the wild side with Lee Livesay and his entire week at Lake Fork as he looked to go back to back on his home lake. Livesay was the local favorite with the most amount of knowledge at Lake Fork, but sometimes that can bite you. In the Marathon Peak Performance of the Event, Livesay wins his third Elite Series title and fourth overall Bassmaster victory in just a span of 18 months.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Crews
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Johns River went to ‪@JohnCrews‬ as he led wire to wire to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch his week from behind the lens as he strived for another major tournament victory as a professional fisherman.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jeff Gustafson
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Bassmaster Classic, watch Jeff Gustafson's dominant performance as he wins for the second time on Fort Loudoun and Tellico. Gussy started strong with 18-8 and 17-3 over Day 1 and 2, but on the final day he needed every bit of his lead to hold off the hard-charging field of anglers looking to make up weight and try to win the Bassmaster Classic

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 7th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, Joey Cifuentes takes the title at Lake St. Clair by going against the grain. Cowboy Cifuentes is a Rookie on the Elite Series but with two wins in 2023, he has wowed the fishing world.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Bryant Schmitt
programme.desc: Bryan Schmitt is one of the winningest anglers in professional fishing and his great track record is noted on grassy river fisheries. Schmitt ended 2022 with a big victory on the Mighty Mississippi River in La Crosse, Wisconsin. Watch his stellar week in the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, watch as Patrick Walters wins his 2nd Elite Series victory and breaks the 100-pound mark for the 3rd time in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Palaniuk
programme.desc: In this Marathon Peak Performance, we take a look at Brandon Palaniuk's amazing 2022 season en route to his second Angler of the Year title.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Benton
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Lake Murray Bassmaster Elite Series, watch Drew Benton's tournament as he notched his 2nd Bassmaster victory. Benton started the week in 2nd place, jumped into the lead, fell to 10th and then completed a comeback of over 5 pounds on the Final Day to win.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Ed Loughran III
programme.desc: Ed Loughran, who is also a practicing attorney, notched his biggest fishing achievement by winning the Bassmaster Elite Series event at Lake Champlain. He leaned on both largemouth and smallmouth en route to his first career victory. He is the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th event of the 2024 Elite Series season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Garrett
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance for the third stop of the Elite Series season features John Garrett and his impressive week at the Harris Chain of Lakes. The former College Champion and current Elite Series rookie led wire to wire and got his first blue trophy in just his 3rd event of the season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Lester
programme.desc: ‪@BrandonLesterFishing‬ fished a flawless week at Pickwick Lake for the 6th stop of the 2022 Bassmaster Elite Series season. Lester took the title and won his first Elite Series title and his second B.A.S.S. win this year. Congratulations to Lester, the Marathon Peak Performance at Pickwick.

programme.title: Peak Performance - LukePalmer
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Luke Palmer has been dubbed as one of the most consistent pros early in his career. His first four years all found him in the 20’s for Angler of the Year and while he’s shown signs of his ability, wins have eluded him. At Santee Cooper he has his Marathon Peak Performance as he follows up a 4th last year, with a win in South Carolina in 2023.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie
programme.desc: Jason Christie led three days of the Elite Series event at the Sabine River and rode a great two days of fishing to the winners circle in his return year to the Bassmaster Elites. He is the Marathon Peak Performance at the Sabine.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Trey Mckinney
programme.desc: One week after turning 19 years old, Trey McKinney became the youngest Bassmaster Elite Series Champion after landing 130 pounds, 15 ounces at Lake Fork for the 2nd stop of the season. Watch his week unfold in this Marathon Peak Performance feature.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Tyler Rivet
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance from Lake Okeechobee, follow Tyler Rivet as he closes in on his first Bassmaster Elite Series title. Rivet is a 5th year Elite Series pro who started his career in college at Nicholls State where he formed a Bass Team and fished in every Bassmaster National Championship during his five years in school.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jay Przekurat
programme.desc: As a 23-year old rookie on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Jay Przekurat made history. In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, Przekurat becomes the youngest Elite Series champion and also breaks 100 pounds for the first time in history for a smallmouth bass event. Watch his week unfold in Clayton, NY.
